name: Fashion Island
description: Fashion Island is Newport Beach's premier outdoor shopping destination, featuring an elegant collection of luxury retailers, upscale dining, and entertainment including a movie theater. Set against the backdrop of the California coast, this iconic lifestyle center offers a refined shopping experience with personal shopping services, seasonal events, and meticulously landscaped grounds that create an inviting atmosphere for locals and visitors alike.
demographics: Affluent coastal community with high household incomes, serving Newport Beach, Corona del Mar, and surrounding Orange County areas with a focus on luxury consumers and tourists seeking premium retail experiences.
summary: An upscale open-air lifestyle center in Newport Beach offering luxury shopping, fine dining, and entertainment with coastal California ambiance.
